headline: The Desk's numbers are computed instead of asserted, readers can answer back — and the Ark inbox explained why the Worker has been unshippable all along.

items.title: Every published number is derived and checkable
items.insight: The improvement was subtraction. 'The desk disagrees' was true on the two stories where it appeared and meaningless on the three with a single voice. A plotted stance axis replaces the assertion; accuracy renders 'Not yet — a record needs 4' instead of a flattering percentage.
items.evidence: api/news-desk-stats.json (200 live) · 16/16 self-tests · modeled in the evidence graph

items.title: Reader reactions as editorial signal
items.insight: Changed my mind / Already knew this / Show more receipts / Made me laugh, plus a per-voice vote feeding a question ORSON actually asks. Identity-free; counts render only when the server returns them, so an unread story shows nothing rather than a fabricated zero.
items.evidence: UI live · 39/39 worker tests incl. a dedupe assertion · endpoint awaiting Worker deploy

items.title: An unread Ark message explained a months-old blocker
items.insight: The Worker gate holds on real-provider-e2e-pending. Draining the inbox showed it can never clear as-is: this site has NO Obelisk sign-in control and is one of 0/43 relying parties still on v1. I had recommended a journey verifier that could never have passed. Reading the inbox a day earlier would have prevented advising the founder wrongly.
items.evidence: Obelisk repo-question 2026-08-10 · live probe state=rejected exact=redirect-not-registered

items.title: Two deploys succeeded having done nothing
items.insight: The content deploy correctly refused to publish five pages referencing a withheld script; the Worker deploy correctly held. Both exited 0. Both would have had me reporting success. Only probing the live artifact for the specific new thing caught either.
items.evidence: would-404 reference resolver · Promotion held — no production mutation

items.title: A crude drawing reached production
items.insight: The torso ran 30px past the leg join, leaving a hanging stroke. Founder-reported, on a live page. Completely invisible in the SVG path data and obvious the instant you look at the rendered image.
items.evidence: queue motif redrawn with arms · re-rendered and inspected (CANON-053)

followUps: Gate that a rendered stat equals its derived source — panel and feed agree by construction today, one refactor from silently not agreeing.
Drain the Ark inbox at /start, not when something breaks.
Obelisk Passport v2 migration — founder-scheduled as its own session; unblocks the promotion hold, reaction counts and the member account shell together.
blockers: Worker promotion gate holds on real-provider-e2e-pending; the journey cannot be verified because the site has no Obelisk sign-in control (0/43 RPs on v2).
Obelisk reports our staging callback registered; a live probe returns redirect-not-registered. Repo-question shipped.
The Dispatch still has zero confirmed subscribers until the founder clicks the double opt-in.
